name: Gastrodon
description: Eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage. Incoming moves also become more likely to miss.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a primeval power. This may also raise the user's offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Mud Bomb
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's defensive stats.

moves.name: Recover
moves.description: The user regenerates its cells to restore its own HP.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.
